title: The Matrix Awakens
binding_check: Each of the 24 kernels retains its 32-bit hit-count UAV at u0 and uses unsigned 64-bit maximum on one, two, or four distinct visibility UAVs starting at u1.
pipeline_check: CreateRootSignature using each original shader container, then CreateComputePipelineStateX through slot 62 with its original bytecode and the source-keyed desktop translation. Check S_OK and a non-null pipeline for each entry.
manifest_encoding: One ASCII line per ascending archive entry containing decimal index, source DXBC SHA-256 and translated DXIL SHA-256 with single spaces and a trailing LF.
scope: Offline shader validation and hardware pipeline creation. Rendered hair and the visibility compaction passes require separate checks.
negative_control: Changing only the first 64-bit maximum at ISA offset 0x604 in global/2458 to a 32-bit maximum leaves conflicting widths on the same UAV. The compiler rejects the resulting shader.
